summary: Regression + additive change verification for LedgerLens iteration 4 (SQLite adapter inactive + new scan-local endpoint + Tauri-only local-folder-card). Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass on live Mongo backend (firm, clients CRUD/404, templates seed+CRUD, file upload/list/soft-delete, full scan pipeline incl. exact_duplicate + wrong_period + missing_doc + unreadable, finding PATCH, CSV/XLSX/PDF reports, cancel-scan 404 + live cancel, and 2 NEW scan-local tests: 400 on invalid folder, 404 on unknown client). Frontend: verified in browser build window.__TAURI__ is false, [data-testid='local-folder-card'] is ABSENT both before and after selecting a client in Scan Workspace; existing upload flow (upload-dropzone, browse-files-button, browse-folder-button, scan-template-select, scan-period-select, start-scan-button) is fully present and unchanged. Nav to Overview & Firm, Client Directory, Checklist Templates, Scan Workspace works. Review/Compare/Reports nav items are gated behind an active client (unchanged pre-existing UX).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /clients/{id}/scan-local correctly returns 404 for unknown client and 400 for non-existent folder (os.path.isdir). Good.
ScanWorkspace.jsx uses isTauri = !!window.__TAURI__ and only conditionally renders the local-folder-card block — confirmed hidden in the browser build. Good.

Refactored helpers _make_progress/_finalize_scan/_load_items are shared by _run_scan and _run_local_scan; full upload-based scan pipeline behaves identically to prior iterations (12/12 regressions pass).
seed_data_creation: Test client 'UI_Test_Client' and 'TEST_Regression Inc' auto-created and cleaned up during tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend runs on Mongo by default (DATA_BACKEND unset). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported to run pytest (not present in shell env). Frontend nav 'Scan Workspace' item in sidebar is disabled until a client is active — reach it via Overview -> 'Start a Scan' or Client Directory. The local-folder-card is Tauri-only; verify absence via [data-testid='local-folder-card'].
